description: Offline, hand-curated question_ref -> use_case_id mapping layer for the skill coverage matrix (BL-004). This is the ONLY place to add a manual mapping. The generator (scripts/build_skill_coverage_matrix.py) reads this file plus deterministic auto-derivation (manifest template_ref == catalog default_spl_template). It NEVER reconstructs the live router and NEVER guesses. Manual entries here take precedence over auto-derivation and are emitted with mapping_status='curated_manual'. Add a row only when an explicit, defensible offline source supports it; record that source in 'evidence'.
rules: Each entry MUST cite an explicit offline evidence source (file + field) in 'evidence'.
Do NOT add a mapping inferred only from fuzzy intent_patterns or query similarity.
mapping_confidence is one of: high | medium | low.
After editing, re-run: python3 scripts/build_skill_coverage_matrix.py && python3 scripts/build_skill_coverage_matrix.py --check
